Focused searches located official LKQ filing evidence for LKQ's distributor role but no reliable evidence resolving the TYC relationship or the 12% market-share scope. Further search was stopped with those atoms unresolved.
LKQ's SEC filing establishes its aftermarket distribution activity, but does not establish a TYC-LKQ supplier or distributor relationship.
The only located source stating 12% is a secondary online summary with no traceable methodology or clearly specified period and market denominator.
No contrary market-share figure was treated as a contradiction because its period and market scope could not be matched to this claim.
